title: Non-movers, linear and circular bots map onto morphotypes 1, 2 and 3

fields.label: Label
fields.value: Non-movers, linear and circular bots map onto morphotypes 1, 2 and 3

fields.label: Statement
fields.value: Anthrobot behaviour and morphology are significantly associated: non-moving bots fall mostly in morphotype 1 (small, smooth, spherical), linear movers mostly in morphotype 2 (large, non-polarized cilia) and circular movers mostly in morphotype 3 (polarized cilia), and no displacing bot was found in morphotype 1.

fields.label: Work
fields.value: Motile Living Biobots Self-Construct from Adult Human Somatic Progenitor Seed Cells

fields.label: Chapter
fields.value: Gumuskaya G 2024, Motile Living Biobots Self-Construct from Adult Human Somatic Progenitor Seed Cells › Results › Distinct Movement Types and Morphotypes are Highly Correlated

fields.label: Quotation
fields.value: We have further computed the statistical significance of these overlaps (using the Fisher test, see Materials and Methods) and conclude that the non‐movers, linear, and circulars significantly correspond with the morphotypes 1, 2 and 3, respectively.

fields.label: Assumptions
fields.value: Gumuskaya G, Srivastava P, Cooper BG, Lesser H, Semegran B, Garnier S, Levin M, “Motile Living Biobots Self-Construct from Adult Human Somatic Progenitor Seed Cells”, Advanced science (Weinheim, Baden-Wurttemberg, Germany) (2024), doi:10.1002/advs.202303575; section “Results › Distinct Movement Types and Morphotypes are Highly Correlated”. Scope: NHBE-derived Anthrobots; 350 imaged bots of which 28 had assigned displacing movement types

fields.label: Assessment
fields.value: GPT-5.6 Sol on levin-2024-anthrobots-14: partially-resolvable, resolvability 0.70

fields.label: Finding
fields.value: The reported association is directly testable from the contingency counts and standard statistics. The small selected movement subset is inadequate for the broader mapping implied by the label.

fields.label: Proposed test in the assessment
fields.value: Proposed test with existing data: Cross-tabulate blinded morphotype and movement assignments and reproduce Fisher tests, including uncertainty from only 28 movement-typed displacers.

fields.label: Evidence against
fields.value:
Only 28 of 350 bots had assigned displacing movement types.

Sampling targeted orthogonal movement categories and may inflate correspondence.

fields.label: Dimension scores
fields.value:
data adequacy: 0.4
discriminating power: 0.75
analysis feasibility: 0.84
operationalizability: 0.96
data existence: 0.6

fields.label: Finding
fields.value: A Fisher test on a behavior-by-morphotype table is a standard check, and the paper states which classes correspond. The contingency table is not public, and the displacing subset is small relative to the imaged cohort. The association cannot be recomputed, or its fragility checked, from open data.

fields.label: Proposed test in the assessment
fields.value: Proposed test with existing data: Cross-tabulate movement class against morphotype for the imaged bots, including the 28 with an assigned displacing type, and repeat the Fisher exact test. Enrichment of non-movers in type 1, linear movers in type 2 and circular movers in type 3, with no displacing bot in type 1, would support the mapping; a flat table would refute it.

fields.label: Evidence against
fields.value:
The bot-level behavior and morphotype labels are not deposited.

Only 28 of about 350 imaged bots carried a displacing movement label.

Movement type and morphotype were both derived by the same investigators, so the overlap inherits both classification choices.

fields.label: Dimension scores
fields.value:
operationalizability: 0.86
data existence: 0.16
discriminating power: 0.45
analysis feasibility: 0.2
data adequacy: 0.2
